name: Auris-en-Oisans
description: Auris-en-Oisans sits on a south-facing slope of the Grandes Rousses massif at 1,600m, facing the Écrins peaks. 300 days of sunshine per year. Own ski area with 19 runs and 12 lifts, linked to the 250km Alpe d'Huez Grand Domaine via the Alpauris chairlift. Glass-enclosed indoor pool with views of the Écrins. 3 spas. Piégut forest — the highest spruce forest in Europe — offers magical snowshoeing. Eco-museum in the hamlet of Cours (traditional barn with rural exhibits). Traditional hamlets with stone houses dating back to Roman times. Family-friendly with kids' club (18 months-12 years). Night sledging, cinema, concerts. Good value satellite of Alpe d'Huez.

overview.atmosphere: Sunny south-facing family resort at 1,600m on the Grandes Rousses. Own 19-run ski area + linked to Alpe d'Huez Grand Domaine (250km) via Alpauris chairlift. Indoor pool, 3 spas, highest spruce forest in Europe for snowshoeing. Eco-museum in Roman-era hamlet.

beyond_skiing.snowshoeing: Piégut forest — highest spruce forest in Europe. Fairytale snowshoe trails through frost-glazed spruce, glistening branches. Wildlife spotting possible.
beyond_skiing.non_ski_activities: Dog sledding, laser game, orienteering, paragliding. Central Oisans location — 25 min to Bourg-d'Oisans, 36 min to Alpe d'Huez, 36 min to Les 2 Alpes.

honest_drawbacks: Quiet apres — limited evening activities beyond family entertainment
Requires Alpauris chairlift to reach full Grand Domaine
